description.en: The traffic direction for the Internet Border.

description.zh: 互联网I白名单地址的类型。
description.en: The type of address in the Internet Border whitelist.

description.zh:
互联网边界白名单的值。

- 当白名单类型为`自定义输入`时：地址簿名称。

- 当白名单类型为`地址簿引用`时：IPv4。
description.en:
The value of the Internet Border whitelist.

- If ListType is set to `Custom`: the name of the address book.

- If ListType is set to `Address book`: the IPv4 address.
The source IP address of the visitor.

description.zh: 互联网边界白名单生效的源或目的类型。
description.en: The type of source or destination for which the Internet Border whitelist takes effect.

descriptions.zh:
## QPS限制
本接口的单用户QPS限制为10次/秒。超过限制，API调用会被限流，这可能会影响您的业务，请合理调用。
descriptions.en:
## QPS limit

This API is limited to 10 queries per second (QPS) for each user. If you exceed this limit, API calls are throttled. This can affect your business. We recommend that you call the API at a reasonable rate.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun cloudfw modify-user-ips-whitelist --source-ip 47.100.XX.XX --lang zh --direction 1 --white-type 2 --list-type 2 --list-value 115.236.36.114/32 --ip-version ipv4 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun cloudfw ModifyUserIPSWhitelist --region cn-hangzhou --WhiteType 2 --SourceIp '47.100.XX.XX' --IpVersion ipv4 --ListType 2 --ListValue '115.236.36.114/32' --Lang zh --Direction 1
